privacy.publicationBasis: Corporate insolvency public-record facts needed to interpret the asset and reserve-price timeline.

location.sourceAssetAddress: Plot No. A-17, SIPCOT IT Park, 5th Cross Road, Siruseri
location.locationEvidence: The auction schedules name Plot A-17 inside SIPCOT IT Park at Siruseri. MITO's verified name crosswalk links Siruseri to registration village 22604:800000275, but no authoritative parcel or park-boundary crosswalk proves that Plot A-17 lies inside that registration polygon.
location.positionalUncertainty: The official notices publish a plot number and road name but no reusable verified asset geometry. MITO does not place Plot A-17 at the park centroid or reuse the approximate park footprint as the building geometry.

asset.assetDescription: Commercial building and its one-acre land component at Plot A-17, SIPCOT IT Park
asset.areaInterpretation: The auction notices state both land and building areas, but the reserve applies to the combined asset. MITO therefore does not derive or publish a land-only rate.

records.calculationMethod: INR 320,000,000 combined-asset reserve divided by the notice's 143,020 square feet of building area; rounded to two decimals.
records.scopeCaveat: This is a liquidation-auction floor for one combined commercial land-and-building asset. The normalized figure uses building area only as a comparison denominator; it is not a land rate, building-only value, winning bid, registered consideration, guideline value, market estimate, current availability or village-wide Siruseri rate.

records.calculationMethod: INR 281,000,000 combined-asset reserve divided by the notice's 143,020 square feet of building area; rounded to two decimals.
records.scopeCaveat: This is a liquidation-auction floor for one combined commercial land-and-building asset. The normalized figure uses building area only as a comparison denominator; it is not a land rate, building-only value, winning bid, registered consideration, guideline value, market estimate, current availability or village-wide Siruseri rate.

reconciliation.outcomeInterpretation: The second notice proves the asset was offered again at a lower reserve. It does not prove that either auction failed, completed, transferred title or achieved a particular bid price.

publication.caveat: MITO publishes two official reserve observations for the same unplotted Siruseri commercial asset. The figures include both land and building, and the location link is a named SIPCOT park association rather than a verified parcel-to-registration-village crosswalk. No winning bid, sale certificate, registered transfer, current ownership or current availability is published.
